meta.title: Replay — Discover, rate and archive your games
meta.description: Replay is the logbook for players: discover games, rate your playthroughs and keep track of everything you have played.

hero.lead: A living library where every game is treated as a work of its own. Build your player journal, one playthrough at a time.
hero.coversLabel: A selection of video game covers

discovery.title: A curated shelf
discovery.lead: A few titles to set the tone. The full catalogue will land with the video game API.
discovery.searchLabel: Search games by title, genre or ID
discovery.searchPlaceholder: Enter a title, genre or ID
discovery.noResults: No games found. Try another search.

discover.title: Discover games
discover.description: Carefully edited pages to explore titles by taste rather than by algorithm.

rate.title: Rate your playthroughs
rate.description: A score, a few words, and the memory of a session stays attached to the game for good.

journal.title: Build your journal
journal.description: Every session joins a personal timeline that tells the story of your year in games.

revisit.title: Find your games again
revisit.description: Finished, dropped, waiting to be resumed: your library stays clear and searchable.
